intel.title: [CISA KEV] Apple Multiple Products - Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-86950
廠商: Apple
產品: Multiple Products
漏洞名稱: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
說明: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-02
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: https://support.apple.com/en-us/149226 ; https://support.apple.com/en-us/149228 ; https://support.apple.com/en-us/149229 ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-86950

analysis.summary: Apple iOS、macOS 及 iPadOS 的 CoreGraphics 框架存在邊界外寫入漏洞（CVE-2026-86950），已被證實存在野外活躍攻擊。攻擊者可利用此漏洞執行任意程式碼，嚴重威脅公司員工使用的 Mac 工作電腦及 iOS 測試裝置安全。
analysis.recommendation:
1. 透過 VMware Workspace ONE (UEM系統) 盤點並強制所有員工之 Mac 電腦（macOS）及行動裝置（iOS/iPadOS）更新至最新安全版本。
2. 針對開發與測試部門（如 RR00, WF40, DA60）之測試機進行全面盤點與升級。
3. 限制未完成更新之裝置存取公司內部敏感系統（如 GitLab、ERP 等）。
affected_assets: 資訊設備-桌上型電腦/筆記型電腦
